products.name: Indium phosphide (InP) substrates (wafers)
products.what_it_is: Thin, polished discs of indium phosphide crystal on which other companies build the lasers and light detectors used in fibre-optic links.
products.analogy: AXT sells the blank canvas; laser makers such as Lumentum and Coherent paint the laser onto it.
products.buyers: Makers of optical components and transceivers for AI and cloud data centers. Named long-term customers: Lumentum (8-K 2026-07-29), Coherent (8-K filed 2026-07-02) and Casela (Zacks 2026-10-05, tier 3: about $25.4m of committed 2027 purchases).
products.how_it_works: AXT grows a single InP crystal in a furnace, slices it into wafers and polishes them. Customers grow thin layers on top to make lasers that send data as light. InP emits light at the wavelengths used in optical fibre, which silicon cannot do well.
products.sales: Q2 2026 InP revenue $30.7m (a record), about 64.5% of total revenue of $47.6m; InP backlog 'exceeding $100 million'. Unit volumes not disclosed. Nothing new in the window.
products.sales_source: AXT Q2 2026 earnings call, 2026-07-30 (Motley Fool transcript https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/03/axt-axti-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/, tier 3); restated by Zacks 2026-10-07 (https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/axti-stock-rises-21-month-142700749.html, tier 3). The press release does not break out InP revenue.
products.stage: Shipping and ramping. InP capacity is to double in 2026 and double again in 2027 (company plan, as restated by Zacks 2026-10-07).
products.size_for_company: The majority of revenue: about 64.5% in Q2 2026.
products.competition: Sumitomo Electric and AXT together make nearly 80% of the world's InP substrates, and JX Advanced Metals about 10% (TrendForce 2026-06-16, https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/06/16/news-jx-advanced-metals-to-invest-jpy-120b-through-fy2030-expand-inp-capacity-up-to-10x-as-cpo-demand-accelerates/). JX plans to invest JPY 120 billion (about $749m) in two Ibaraki plants through fiscal 2030, reaching 7-10 times its fiscal 2025 capacity (same source). Sumitomo Electric is committing about JPY 18 billion (about $120m) to reach 3.1 times its fiscal 2024 InP capacity by fiscal 2028 (TrendForce 2026-07-13, https://www.trendforce.com/news/2026/07/13/news-sumitomo-electric-to-raise-inp-substrate-expansion-scale-with-jpy-18-billion/). These Japanese rivals do not need Chinese export permits.
products.why_investors_care: InP wafers are a bottleneck material for AI optical links. AXT is one of the two largest makers, and customers are prepaying to reserve its output.
products.watch_next: Q3 InP revenue on 2026-10-29; any Chinese export permits for US customers; capacity progress against the plan to double in 2026.

products.name: Coherent master development and supply agreement (contract)
products.what_it_is: A three-year contract under which Coherent prepays AXT to secure 6-inch InP wafer substrates.
products.analogy: A large deposit paid to a supplier to hold your place in the queue; it is later used up as you buy.
products.buyers: Coherent Corp (a US maker of lasers and optical transceivers).
products.how_it_works: Coherent paid a prepayment of US$22,288,500, which is applied to its product purchases. If Coherent does not meet the minimum order quantity requirement, the unused prepayment becomes nonrefundable. Signed 2026-06-26, effective 2026-06-25, initial term three years.
products.sales: Total contract value not disclosed; prepayment US$22,288,500.
products.size_for_company: The prepayment equals about 47% of AXT's Q2 2026 revenue ($22.3m vs $47.6m).
products.competition: Coherent could also buy from Sumitomo Electric or JX Advanced Metals.
products.why_investors_care: It is a second prepaid deal besides Lumentum's. Thesis 2 / pillar 4 ('other customers sign similar prepaid deals') already has this support, but the thesis file does not mention it.
products.watch_next: Whether the Q3 10-Q shows the Coherent and Lumentum deposits received and shipments made, given that US-customer permits are still not issued.
